mechanism: Bind the source U top bar and its two feet to an exact local U in the second pattern. The local fit invites counting all five patterns as buildable, overlooking that this pattern has only eight small rectangles rather than ten. Open edge highlights avoid a new closed partition contour.
primary_unique_math_proof: The source block comprises five 2-by-1 rectangles. Patterns below contain10,8,10,10,10 rectangles. The eight-rectangle pattern cannot use exactly two blocks of area5 rectangles each. Exhaustive rigid lattice placement enumeration in tiling_math_audit.json supplies disjoint two-copy covers for each of the other four patterns, including 90-degree rotated copies in the final vertical pattern. Hence exactly four patterns can be made.
primary_human_clarity_assessment: Ten partial color operations select existing top and foot boundary edges. No new cut is drawn and no complete colored source partition is enclosed. The three leftover rectangles in the eight-cell pattern, all other patterns and every original seam stay visible.
